transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a significant issue. My review of the October collections file, completed yesterday and still in my working paper pending the monthly risk-pack circulation, shows 6% historical dilution rather than the 3% assumed in the draft. Under our risk methodology, this requires an 8% dilution reserve. Additionally, $4,000,000 of the receivables are affiliate balances that must be excluded, leaving an eligible pool of exactly $26,000,000 rather than $30,000,000. The draft transaction assumptions need to be revised before approval.

transcript.text: Maya, I also need to flag a critical legal issue. I received the transaction counsel memo this morning and have not yet attached it to the closing checklist. The memo confirms that the structure qualifies as a true sale only if two conditions are met: first, the seller has no recourse for ordinary obligor credit losses, and second, a UCC financing statement is perfected before the 2026-11-20 funding date. Both of these conditions must be satisfied before we can proceed to closing, or the true sale characterization of the securitization will fail.
